	icon = privilege_government
	land_share = 3
	max_absolutism = -5
	loyalty = 0.05
	influence = 0.05
	is_valid = {
		jxp_is_japanese_polity_trigger = yes
		OR = { has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_market_stage_3 has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_market_stage_4 }
	}
	can_select = {
		is_bankrupt = no
		crown_land_share = 15
	}
	can_revoke = { always = yes }
	on_granted = {}
	on_revoked = {}
	on_invalid = {}
	benefits = { global_trade_goods_size_modifier = 0.05 }
	penalties = { global_unrest = 0.5 }
	cooldown_years = 10
	ai_will_do = {
		factor = 1
		modifier = { factor = 0 is_bankrupt = yes }
		modifier = { factor = 0.20 NOT = { crown_land_share = 25 } NOT = { has_estate_privilege = jxp_a_villages_common_workshops } }
		modifier = { factor = 0.25 estate_influence = { estate = jxp_estate_village_communes influence = 70 } NOT = { has_estate_privilege = jxp_a_villages_common_workshops } }
		modifier = { factor = 2 has_estate_privilege = jxp_a_villages_common_workshops NOT = { estate_loyalty = { estate = jxp_estate_village_communes loyalty = 35 } } }
		modifier = { factor = 1.20 monthly_income = 20 }
		modifier = { factor = 1.45 OR = { current_age = age_of_absolutism current_age = age_of_revolutions } }
		modifier = { factor = 1.50 jxp_a_market_stage_at_least_2_trigger = yes }
		modifier = { factor = 1.60 jxp_a_company_has_at_least_1_trigger = yes }
		modifier = { factor = 0.35 OR = { NOT = { stability = 0 } has_spawned_rebels = anti_tax_rebels has_any_estate_disaster_active = yes } }
	}
}
